name: Coordinated Maneuvers [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You are skilled at working with your allies to perform dangerous combat maneuvers.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally, your ally receives a +2 competence bonus on all combat maneuver checks. This bonus increases to +4 when attempting to break free from a grapple.
